summary: We translated a complex payments idea into a real platform. From product brief to launch in 14 weeks.
body: Bibi came to us with an idea and a deck. We started with a 2-week discovery, then designed the full product system before writing code. The platform shipped on time, integrated Paystack and M-Pesa from day one, and crossed 1,200 active users within the first month.

summary: A clinical-records platform built with care. Compliance, audit trails, and a UI that nurses actually want to use.
body: We spent the first phase mapping clinical workflows with three nurses on staff. The result is a records platform that sits in the background and surfaces only what matters. Compliance audits passed on the first try.

summary: A growth roadmap that saved months and a lot of money. We challenged scope and got to launch fast.
body: Tom expected designers. He got product partners. We pushed back on a third of the original scope, shipped the smaller version first, and used the saved time to find product-market fit with paying customers.
